The '''''Exactor''''' was the second [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperator''-class Star Destroyer]] to be produced. It was one of the first ships of a design that would later become infamous under the name ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer.<ref name="DL:TRODV" />

==History==
The ''Exactor'' was constructed early on in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TCW:TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' has ''Imperator''s being fielded early in the war.</ref> and later served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] for some time following the end of the conflict.<ref name="DL:TRODV" /> The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was also stationed onboard.<ref name="SWDT4">[[Dark Times 4|''Dark Times'' 4]]</ref>

Under Vader's command, the ''Exactor'' visited worlds such as [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] during a hunt for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survivors of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and rogue [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]],<ref name="DL:TRODV" /> as well as [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to subjugate the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species.<ref name="DL:TRODV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Despite it being the second of what would become the ''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers, the artist erroneously illustrated ''Exactor'' with the communications tower of an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]].
